ui.title: ABRP Driving Dashboard
ui.subtitle: EV — distance statistics, charging behavior & providers

settings.token_hint: Your ABRP API key (free at iternio.com/api). Stored locally in your browser.
settings.connections_hint: Connect your car to automatically fetch trips and charging data. Choose your brand below.

help.title: ❓ Help — How the dashboard works
help.total_driven_desc: All kilometers driven in the selected period. The number below shows the trip count.
help.total_charged_desc: Total kWh charged across all charging sessions. The number below shows the session count.
help.consumption_desc: Average energy consumption in kWh per 100 km. Calculated as: total kWh charged ÷ total km × 100. Lower = more efficient.
help.active_days_desc: Number of unique days with driving activity. Subtext shows average km per active day.
help.top_provider_desc: Which charging provider you use most (e.g. DATS 24, Fastned, Allego). Subtext shows how often you charged there.
help.longest_trip_desc: The longest single trip in kilometers within the selected period.
help.sessions_provider_desc: Shows the number of charges per provider. Each color represents a different provider.
help.energy_provider_desc: Shows how much kWh you charged per provider. Useful to see where you get most energy.
help.charge_locations_desc: Overview of each charge location with session count, total kWh, and last visit date.
help.distance_period_desc: Bar chart with total km per day, week, month, or year — depending on the active filter.
help.energy_charged_desc: Bar chart with total kWh charged per period.
help.soc_trend_desc: Line chart of the average battery charge (State of Charge) at the start of each period. A declining line means you start driving with less battery on average.
help.odometer_desc: Line chart of the vehicle's odometer over time. Shows how fast the car accumulates mileage.
help.weekday_desc: Bar chart with number of trips per day of the week (Mon-Sun). Helps understand which days you drive most.
help.distribution_desc: Doughnut chart with trip distribution in distance categories: 0-10 km (short), 10-50 km (commute), 50-100 km (regional), 100-200 km (long), 200+ km (very long).
help.filters_intro: Use the filter buttons at the top to choose how data is grouped:
help.filter_day_desc: Each individual day as a separate column/row
help.filter_all_desc: All data combined into one period
help.filters_note: All charts update immediately when changing the filter.
help.upload_desc: Click Upload and select one or more ABRP Excel exports. The server parses the files, converts miles to km, detects charge providers, and merges everything.
help.vw_desc: In Settings you can link your VW account (free). Click Sync to fetch trips and charging data directly from Volkswagen servers.
help.abrp_desc: For premium ABRP API keys. Save your token in Settings to fetch activities directly from ABRP.
help.dark_light_desc: Switch between dark and light appearance. Preference is saved in your browser.
help.palette_desc: Choose from 6 color palettes: Default, Warm, Ocean, Forest, Sunset, Mono. All charts change colors instantly.
help.export_desc: Click PDF to save the entire dashboard (all cards, charts, and tables) as a PDF report.
help.mobile_desc: The dashboard works on phones and tablets. KPI cards show in 2 columns, charts stack vertically, and tables scroll horizontally with touch.
help.privacy_desc: All data stays local on your Raspberry Pi. The server sends no data to external servers unless you explicitly use WeConnect or ABRP API.
help.language_desc: The dashboard supports multiple languages. Download a template, translate it, and upload your own language file in Settings.
